mapper.select: select x.insp_line_id, x.char_id, h.item_id, h.insp_type, h.proc_id, h.insp_no, h.judged_at, h.lot_id, x.data_type from qms_insp h join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_id = h.insp_id and x.data_type in ('VARIABLE', 'ATTRIBUTE') where h.insp_id = #{inspId} and h.status = 'JUDGED' order by x.line_no, x.insp_line_id

with g as ( select x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, x.lsl, x.usl, min(m.occurred_at) as first_at from qms_insp h join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_id = h.insp_id and x.char_id = #{charId} and x.data_type = 'VARIABLE' join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join qms_insp_meas m on m.insp_line_id = x.insp_line_id and m.void_of_id is null and m.value is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) where h.item_id = #{itemId} and h.insp_type = #{inspType} and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint group by x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, x.lsl, x.usl ) select g.* from g where (g.first_at, g.insp_line_id) <= (select t.first_at, t.insp_line_id from g t where t.insp_line_id = #{lineId}) order by g.first_at desc, g.insp_line_id desc limit #{limit}

insert into qms_spc_event (comp_cd, limit_id, item_id, char_id, insp_type, proc_id, insp_id, insp_line_id, rule_cd, n, point_mean, point_range, z, center, sigma, chart_type, occurred_at, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{limitId}, #{line.itemId}, #{line.charId}, #{line.inspType}, #{line.procId}, #{insp}, #{line.inspLineId}, #{rule}, #{n}, #{mean}, #{range}, #{z}, #{center}, #{sigma}, #{chartType}, #{line.judgedAt}, #{by}) on conflict (insp_line_id, rule_cd) do nothing returning event_id

with g as ( select x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, min(m.occurred_at) as first_at, count(*)::integer as n, (count(*) filter (where m.ok_yn = 'N'))::integer as d from qms_insp h join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_id = h.insp_id and x.char_id = #{charId} and x.data_type = 'ATTRIBUTE' join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join qms_insp_meas m on m.insp_line_id = x.insp_line_id and m.void_of_id is null and m.ok_yn is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) where h.item_id = #{itemId} and h.insp_type = #{inspType} and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint group by x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no ) select g.* from g where (g.first_at, g.insp_line_id) <= (select t.first_at, t.insp_line_id from g t where t.insp_line_id = #{lineId}) order by g.first_at desc, g.insp_line_id desc limit #{limit}

insert into qms_spc_event_act (comp_cd, event_id, act_type, note, acted_by) select e.comp_cd, e.event_id, 'VOID', #{note}, #{by} from qms_spc_event e where e.insp_id = #{inspId} and not exists (select 1 from qms_spc_event_act a where a.event_id = e.event_id and a.act_type in ('CLOSE', 'VOID')) order by e.event_id returning event_id
select lot_id from qms_insp where insp_id = #{inspId}
